Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM

DECLARE
v_skill varchar2(50);
v_date date;
cursor c2 is 
 select distinct job_code
 from employee_jobs
 where staff_no = :employees_ctrl.staff_no
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and job_code != 'OVRAL';
BEGIN
 for c2_rec in c2 
 loop
 if v_skill is null then
 v_skill := c2_rec.job_code;
 else
 v_skill := v_skill||','||c2_rec.job_code;
 end if;
 end loop;
 :employees_ctrl.skill := v_skill ;
END ;

declare
 v_date date;

BEGIN 
 v_date := to_date(:global.v_sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 select Initcap(first_name)||' '||Initcap(last_name) name, 
 facility_code, mix_team, team_seq, emp_class, supervisor
 into :employees_ctrl.name, :employees_ctrl.facility_code, :employees_ctrl.mix_team,
 :employees_ctrl.team_seq, :employees_ctrl.emp_class, :employees_ctrl.supervisor
 from employees
 where staff_no = :employees_ctrl.staff_no
 and emp_class in (select distinct code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'MANAS')
 and emp_class not in ('FSTAF')
 and v_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_date+1)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 NULL;
END ;

 :employees_ctrl.team_id := :ctrl_block.team_id ;

BEGIN
 select skill_rating
 into :employees_ctrl.skill_rating
 from employee_jobs
 where staff_no = :employees_ctrl.staff_no
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and job_code = 'OVRAL';
EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 NULL;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
al_id Alert;
al_button number;
v_team_id varchar2(10);
v_date date;
begin
--message(get_item_property('employees_ctrl.staff_no',UPDATEABLE));pause;
/***
message('form..'||:system.form_status);pause;
message('block..'||:system.block_status);pause;
message('record..'||:system.record_status);pause;
***/
if :employees_ctrl.staff_no is not null then
BEGIN
 v_date := to_date(:global.v_sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 select nvl(team_id, 'X')
 into v_team_id
 from employees
 where staff_no = :employees_ctrl.staff_no
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and emp_class in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'MANAS')
 and v_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_date + 1);
 
 IF v_team_id = 'X' THEN
 next_item; 
 ELSIF v_team_id != :ctrl_block.team_id THEN
 al_id := Find_Alert('TEAM_ALERT');
 IF Id_Null(al_id) THEN
 Message('TEAM ALERT does not exist'); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 ELSE 
 set_alert_property(al_id,ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,'The staff is assigned in another team, Do you want to reassign to'||:ctrl_block.team_id||'?');
 al_button := Show_Alert(al_id); 
 IF al_button = ALERT_BUTTON2 THEN 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 ELSE
 next_item;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF v_team_id = :ctrl_block.team_id and :CTRL_BLOCK.EMPTY_FLAG = 'Y' THEN
 al_id := Find_Alert('ERROR_ALERT');
 IF Id_Null(al_id) THEN
 Message('TEAM ALERT does not exist'); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 ELSE 
 set_alert_property(al_id,ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT,'The staff is already assigned to'||:ctrl_block.team_id||'.');
 al_button := Show_Alert(al_id); 
 IF al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN 
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('12006');
 check_package_failure;
 END;
next_item;
end if;
end;

PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
v_local_time date;
v_sysdate varchar2(20);
BEGIN

--:global.program_version := '1.01.04';
--:global.program_version := '2.03.00';

--:global.program_version := '06'; -- Sysdate conversion for eff_date

--:global.program_version := '08'; -- IM 8497

 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 :global.program_version := '01';
 
execute_trigger('util_banner');
set_item_property('toolbar.delete_record',enabled,property_false);
set_item_property('toolbar.INSERT',enabled,property_false);

 -- time zone change --04/14/11--sandip

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_CONTROL_BLOCK_ITEMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE set_control_block_items(action IN varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.TEAM_ID' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.team_id',action);
 end if;
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLOCK.TEAM_DESC' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.team_desc', action);
 end if; 
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.facility_code',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_fac',action);
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_team_id',action);
 if action = 'E' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.pb_team_id',NAVIGABLE,property_false);
 
end if;
END;

cursor c1 (v_date date) is select staff_no
 from employees
 where team_id = :ctrl_block.team_id
 and emp_class in (select distinct code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'MANAS'
 )
 and emp_class not in ('FSTAF')
 and v_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_date+1)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 order by team_seq;
 v_date1 date;
begin
 v_date1 := to_date(:global.v_sysdate, 'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI');
 go_block('employees_ctrl');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 for c1_rec in c1(v_date1) 
 loop
 :employees_ctrl.staff_no := c1_rec.staff_no;
 next_record;
 end loop; 
 first_record;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMMIT_STAFF
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE commit_staff IS
v_staff_no varchar2(20);
BEGIN
 first_record; 
 loop
 if :system.record_status not in('INSERT','NEW') then
 update employees
 set mix_team = :employees_ctrl.mix_team,
 team_seq = :employees_ctrl.team_seq
 where staff_no = :employees_ctrl.staff_no;
 else
 update employees
 set mix_team = :employees_ctrl.mix_team,
 team_seq = :employees_ctrl.team_seq, 
 team_id = :ctrl_block.team_id
 where staff_no = :employees_ctrl.staff_no;
 end if;

 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
 first_record;
 :system.message_level :=10;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;

if form_success then
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
end if;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMMIT_MASTER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE commit_master IS
BEGIN
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from valid_master_codes
 where code = :ctrl_block.team_id
 and description = :ctrl_block.team_desc
 and sort_sequence_1 = :ctrl_block.sort_seq_fac
 and code_type = 'TEAMS';
exception
 when no_data_found then
 update valid_master_codes
 set description = :ctrl_block.team_desc, 
 sort_sequence_1 = :ctrl_block.sort_seq_fac
 where code = :ctrl_block.team_id
 and code_type = 'TEAMS';
END;
